tests.name: Copilot CLI: counts a normal session's facets by rule
tests.why: new parser for CLI history; checks each rule-made facet on a made-up normal session

tests.name: VS Code: replays the chat mutation log and counts its facets
tests.why: new parser for VS Code chat files; checks the same facets

tests.name: reads incrementally: only files changed since the last read are parsed again, and broken ones are counted as skipped
tests.why: asserts a facet a source lacks is left out of its available list (not-available, not zero)

tests.name: Copilot CLI: a truncated last line and unknown events are skipped, the rest still counts
tests.why: defensive parsing: unparsable lines skipped, rest counted

tests.name: a history root that is itself a link is not read, and the source is reported as unsafe
tests.why: added in a fix round: a linked root is refused and flagged

tests.name: a linked folder anywhere below a root is not followed
tests.why: links deeper in the VS Code tree are not followed

tests.name: a missing source shows nothing, and links out of a history folder are not followed
tests.why: a missing root yields no source entry; title echoes the MUST's 'missing ... shows nothing' wording

tests.name: Insights shows Copilot CLI and VS Code history as their own groups, with a source filter and the sessions that could not be read
tests.why: groups per source, filter buttons, window switch; title echoes 'own group with a filter'

map.none: no test checks that history data is not sent to a model, logged or written outside the store

tests.name: reads incrementally: only files changed since the last read are parsed again, and broken ones are counted as skipped
tests.why: only the changed file is re-parsed; title quotes 'changed since the last read'

tests.name: a large snapshot is parsed off the host thread, so the host's timers keep firing
tests.why: host event loop stays responsive while a big file parses (non-blocking)

tests.name: a read that never answers times out as that source's failure, ends its worker, and the next read starts a fresh one
tests.why: a stalled read is bounded by a deadline, so it cannot hang the host's requests

tests.name: Copilot CLI: a truncated last line and unknown events are skipped, the rest still counts
tests.why: the truncated and unknown-event fixture case the MUST lists, by those words

tests.name: VS Code: a huge session is replayed
tests.why: the huge-session fixture case the MUST lists

tests.name: reads incrementally: only files changed since the last read are parsed again, and broken ones are counted as skipped
tests.why: the host test of incremental reading the MUST asks for

tests: tests/unit/history.test.ts::a history root that is itself a link is not read, and the source is reported as unsafe
findings.note: the linked-root test spells the root without a trailing slash or dot, so it passes while those spellings still slip past the refusal; only a new test with those spellings would fail at head, and since the base has no reader at all a fail-on-base check cannot isolate it (finding was ruled rejected)

notes: Base is main's commit from the branch's newest merge; history.test.ts and src/host/history.ts are new against it, so on the base every unit test fails at import rather than on an assertion. No describe blocks: names are bare titles. The extra e2e test for unsafe/timeout problems (Playwright) also touches MUST 2 and 5 but was not listed to stay within 3 per MUST. Report found only in insights-history-review.jsonl (final message). Strict marks are judgement calls on title wording; no test cites a MUST number.
